title: Turning toward a voice is a four-month CDC milestone
summary: Most babies turn their head toward the sound of your voice by four months, the CDC says.
body: CDC places head-turning toward a caregiver voice at four months. Household clatter is not the stimulus. Ages on the page mark what a large majority can do, and missing the item is a prompt to speak with a doctor, not a label by itself.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports 'Turns head towards the sound of your voice' by four months for most children (75% or more).
